top_signals.title: US-Canada Cosmetic Tariffs Threaten the $10 Beauty Impulse Buy
top_signals.summary: In between offering advice on how to find the best towels and where to buy affordable versions of high-end garments, Bryce Gruber recently waded into the US-Canada trade war, warning her social-media followers that some of their favorite makeup is about to get more expensive.
